evals.prompt: I have a 1.2 kb gene in a FASTA file and want a quick go/no-go on whether it expresses. How do I order a cell-free protein expression validation on Ginkgo Cloud Lab and what will it cost?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ginkgo-cloud. Routes to the Cell Free Protein Expression Validation protocol on cloud.ginkgo.bio: submit the FASTA (up to 1800 bp), expect expression confirmation, baseline titer (mg/L), and virtual gel images at $39/sample with a turnaround of up to 10 days (as listed; confirm on the protocol page), walking through the ordering workflow.

evals.prompt: My membrane protein won't express well. Can Ginkgo Cloud Lab screen multiple conditions to optimize expression?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ginkgo-cloud. Routes to Cell Free Protein Expression Optimization: DoE-based screening across up to 24 conditions per protein (lysates, temperatures, chaperones, disulfide enhancers, cofactors), designed for difficult-to-express and membrane proteins, at $199/sample, turnaround up to 11 days.

assertions.value: Recommends the optimization protocol with its DoE multi-condition screening for membrane/difficult proteins.

evals.prompt: I want to turn a 64x64 pixel-art PNG of our lab logo into living fluorescent bacterial art. Is that something Ginkgo Cloud Lab can do?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ginkgo-cloud. Routes to Fluorescent Pixel Art Generation: the logo is uploaded into the Design Tool, which maps its colors to the 7-strain fluorescent E. coli palette on an Echo 1536 (32x48-dot) plate; printed by acoustic dispensing and delivered as high-res UV photographs at $25/plate (Beta), and walks through ordering.

evals.prompt: My workflow isn't one of the listed Ginkgo protocols. How do I get a feasibility assessment and price for a custom protocol on the cloud lab?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ginkgo-cloud. Directs the user to the EstiMate AI agent, which accepts a plain-language protocol description and returns a compatibility/feasibility assessment and pricing for custom workflows beyond the listed protocols.

evals.prompt: Before I pay for a Ginkgo cell-free expression run, check my constructs in cfps_constructs.fasta — are any of them too long or not valid DNA for the protocol? I don't have a Ginkgo account set up yet.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ginkgo-cloud on the keyless path (e.g. scripts/check_cfps_input.py) with no account: checks each construct against the CFPS Validation limits (linear DNA, up to 1800 bp, ACGT/IUPAC only) and reports gene_ok_short (717 bp) as fine, gene_too_long (1875 bp) as over the 1800 bp limit, and gene_bad_chars as invalid because it contains U (an RNA base). Notes the sample count and estimated cost ($39/sample, confirm on the protocol page) and that the order is placed in the cloud.ginkgo.bio web UI, without submitting anything.

assertions.value: Flags gene_too_long as over 1800 bp and gene_bad_chars for the U, passes gene_ok_short, and gives the sample count/cost, all offline without an account.

evals.prompt: I have a 64x64 PNG of our lab logo. Without a Ginkgo account, prep it for the fluorescent pixel-art protocol: which of the 7 strains map to my colours and will it fit the plate layout?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ginkgo-cloud and prepares the design offline with no account: maps the image's colours to the 7-strain fluorescent E. coli palette (sfGFP green, mRFP1 red, mKO2 orange, Venus yellow-green, mTurquoise2 cyan, Electra2 blue, mScarlet-I scarlet), notes a 64x64 image exceeds the Echo 1536 32x48-dot layout so it must be downscaled/cropped (the 6144 64x96 layout is announced), and describes uploading the result into the Design Tool. Gives price/turnaround ($25/plate, Beta) and that ordering is in the web UI, without placing an order.

assertions.value: Maps colours to the 7-strain palette and checks the design against the 32x48 Echo 1536 layout offline, noting a 64x64 image does not fit as-is, without needing an account.

evals.prompt: Put together a ready-to-order Ginkgo CFPS validation package for the three constructs in cfps_constructs.fasta at 3 replicates each: what will it cost, how many samples, and what should I drop in the Additional Details field? No account yet.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ginkgo-cloud and assembles the order offline with no account: validates the three constructs (noting gene_too_long and gene_bad_chars must be fixed or dropped before ordering), computes the sample count (valid constructs x 3 replicates) and the estimated cost at $39/sample, and drafts Additional Details (construct notes, any special handling). States the price/turnaround are as listed and must be confirmed on the protocol page, and that the order is placed in the cloud.ginkgo.bio web UI — it does not submit.

assertions.value: Validates the constructs, computes samples x replicates and cost at $39/sample, and drafts the order package offline, without placing an order.

evals.prompt: I designed 40 minibinder sequences against EGFR and want them expressed and tested for binding affinity at the Adaptyv Bio Foundry. How do I submit the experiment?
evals.expected_output: Does NOT invoke this skill; defers to alterlab-adaptyv. The user names the Adaptyv Bio Foundry and its protein binding assays, which the Adaptyv skill covers (submission, tracking, pre-submission sequence optimization); Ginkgo Cloud Lab is a different provider.

evals.prompt: Write me an Opentrons Flex protocol that does a serial dilution across a 96-well plate on our own robot in the lab.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT invoke this skill; defers to alterlab-opentrons. The user is programming their own Opentrons hardware with the Protocol API, not submitting a protocol to Ginkgo's remote autonomous cloud lab (RACs).
